subject: CAIQ runtime telemetry: slices & evidence handshake
messages:
From: Emma Lawson <emma@glacier-analytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: security@glacier-analytics.com, procure@glacier-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ request — runtime telemetry & evidence slices

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call last week. Glacier is running a CAIQ review against vendor runtime controls that map to our telemetry and observability requirements. We need two things from Redwood to complete our assessment: a control crosswalk for the CAIQ controls that touch runtime telemetry (logs, traces, KV cache, request/response headers) and a small set of sanitized log extracts that demonstrate the controls in action (example: tokenization/redaction, access logs showing operator IDs, and a sampling of cache eviction events).

A few constraints:
- We can accept sanitized logs with PII removed; please annotate the redaction approach.
- Send samples covering a 72-hour window and include timezone stamps (UTC preferred).
- We need a mapping to CAIQ control IDs and your terse narrative for each control (one paragraph max).

Can you provide the crosswalk and the first set of samples by Fri, 5 Mar? If you need an NDA addendum or DocuSign route for extra attachments, let us know and procurement can expedite.

Also include any internal owner we can contact if there are follow-ups.

Best,
Emma Lawson
CISO, Glacier Analytics
emma@glacier-analytics.com

--
Glacier Analytics | security@glacier-analytics.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lawson <emma@glacier-analytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ request — runtime telemetry & evidence slices

Emma — thanks, we can do this. I'm attaching a first-pass crosswalk (caiq_telemetry_mapping_v1.xlsx) that maps the CAIQ runtime/telemetry controls we believe are in scope to Redwood's artifacts and owners. High level answers inline below for immediate pickup:

- Sampling window: we will provide a 72-hour slice (UTC) for a non-prod tenant and a redacted runtime snapshot from the last 30 days for artifacts (log-index pointers).
- Sanitation: Rishi will produce redacted logs. Approach: automated PII tokenization + manual review for IPs/hostnames; we will include a redaction manifest.
- Control narratives: one-paragraph rationale included in the spreadsheet for each control ID.

A couple of clarifying asks before we deliver:
1) Do you need KV cache internal vectors (KV cache hit/miss traces) or only external request logs and operator access events?
2) Will Glacier accept a secure Drive link for artifacts or do you require DocuSign/attachment by procurement?

I'll route to the owners internally once you confirm. Attaching the mapping now (v1) — expect a revised v2 after Rishi's sample extraction.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

Attachments: caiq_telemetry_mapping_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with CAIQ control mapping and short narratives)

Subject: Deliverable: CAIQ runtime telemetry crosswalk + sanitized samples (v1)

Emma — attached is the agreed v1 package for Glacier's CAIQ runtime/telemetry review. Deliverables in this message:

1) caiq_telemetry_mapping_v1.xlsx (attached) — a crosswalk mapping each CAIQ control we scoped to Redwood artifacts, the brief narrative (one paragraph per control), and the internal owner. Notable mappings included: CCM-Runtime-07 (request logging) -> docs + streaming access logs; CCM-Telemetry-03 (cache lifecycle) -> KV cache eviction traces and telemetry index. (See spreadsheet for full mapping and short rationale.)

2) redwood_log_snippets_202702.tar.gz — a 72-hour sanitized extract from a non-prod tenant (UTC timestamps). Contents: access_logs_72h.log (sanitized), eviction_traces.log (KV cache events), operator_actions.log (operator ID redacted to tokenized ids). We also included a redaction_manifest.txt describing automated and manual redaction steps.

3) caiq_control_rationale.pdf — short, signed control narratives for audit packaging.

Delivery notes and next steps:
- Files are available at: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_drive_link (access granted to your security group).
- If you require DocuSign-backed transfer, procurement can use the link: DOCUSIGN: https://app.docusign.com/link/NDA-Glacier-2027.
- We recommend an intake call Thurs (3/4) or Fri (3/5) to walk the artifacts; please propose a time and we'll invite owners.

Short answers to your clarifying questions:
- KV cache traces: included (eviction events and hit/miss counters) as requested.
- Delivery method: Drive link is acceptable; procurement can escalate if you need DocuSign.

If Glacier needs additional production-level sampling or a live walkthrough of instrumentation, we'll scope that as a follow-up (may require a short SOW).

Thanks — looping Jonas/Marissa/Rishi in case you want direct follow-ups.

Best,
Kimberly Park
